title: Block Sensitivity and Certificate Complexity of Rotation Symmetric Boolean Functions
summary: We study block sensitivity and certificate complexity of rotation symmetric Boolean functions, with particular emphasis on monomial rotation symmetric Boolean functions. We first show that every odd-degree monomial rotation symmetric Boolean function on $n$ variables satisfies $s=bs=C=n$. We then determine sensitivity, block sensitivity, and certificate complexity for every quadratic monomial rotation symmetric Boolean function.
